rawContent: Here in @NewhamLondon we declared a #ClimateEmergency in 2019, followed by a plan of action to get to carbon neutral by 2030 & climate zero by 2050. In June, our 2nd annual report will set out how we’ll help to cut greenhouse emissions by 78% by 2035.  @newham_labour https://t.co/ihLjuT9XDx
